name: Sales & BD
mandate: Turn approved enquiries into qualified opportunities, evidence-backed proposals and complete delivery handoffs.
focus: Build a reliable path from enquiry to signed scope.
starterTasks: Confirm the pipeline system and sales owner
Approve service claims and proposal examples
Define qualification and handoff criteria

workflows.name: Proposal brief
workflows.description: Structure a proposal from an approved service, client need and evidence.
workflows.placeholder: Client objective, audience, outcomes, scope and constraints. Use anonymised details for a trial.

workflows.name: Lead qualification
workflows.description: Prepare a qualification record with explicit missing information.
workflows.placeholder: Need, decision maker, urgency, budget if supplied, source and next conversation.

workflows.name: Follow-up draft
workflows.description: Prepare a follow-up for a human to review and send.
workflows.placeholder: What was agreed, approved resources to share, and the requested next step.

name: Marketing
mandate: Plan and prepare brand-consistent content using approved claims and permissioned proof points.
focus: Keep every public claim connected to an approved source.
starterTasks: Confirm channel owners and publishing rights
Approve brand voice and claim register
Map the next content calendar

workflows.name: Social content pack
workflows.description: Organise three content angles for a selected campaign.
workflows.placeholder: Audience, service, channel, message, approved proof and call to action.

workflows.name: Article outline
workflows.description: Build a brief, outline and metadata plan for an article.
workflows.placeholder: Topic, target reader, question to answer, approved sources and relevant services.

name: Consulting Delivery
mandate: Translate signed scopes into diagnosis, programme design, delivery plans and measured evaluations.
focus: Make the agreed scope traceable through delivery and evaluation.
starterTasks: Confirm engagement owners and access boundaries
Collect approved TNA and programme templates
Define evaluation milestones and evidence

workflows.name: Training needs analysis pack
workflows.description: Prepare a diagnosis plan from the stated business and capability needs.
workflows.placeholder: Business outcomes, audience, current capability gaps, constraints and signed scope reference.

workflows.name: 30 / 60 / 90 evaluation
workflows.description: Structure evaluation findings against an agreed baseline.
workflows.placeholder: Review interval, agreed KPIs, baseline, observations and actual evidence. Leave unknown values unknown.

name: Technology & AI
mandate: Assess automation opportunities and specify bounded AI systems with tested tools, data routes and human escalation.
focus: Define the process, evidence and operating boundary before automation.
starterTasks: Document approved model and hosting routes
Inventory connector scopes and credentials owners
Define agent evaluation and release gates

workflows.name: Automation opportunity assessment
workflows.description: Map a process and its automation constraints before choosing tools.
workflows.placeholder: Trigger, steps, systems, owners, volumes if measured, exceptions and desired outcome.

workflows.name: AI agent requirements
workflows.description: Prepare an agent specification with tools, sources and release tests.
workflows.placeholder: Role, users, sources, allowed actions, prohibited actions, escalation and operating region.

name: Finance
mandate: Prepare finance work for review while preserving the accounting system as the source of truth.
focus: Keep monetary facts and posting decisions with the finance owner.
starterTasks: Confirm the accounting system and finance reviewer
Approve invoice fields and tax treatment
Define restricted finance access

workflows.name: Invoice preparation brief
workflows.description: Collect approved commercial and tax inputs before invoice preparation.
workflows.placeholder: Legal entity, client, signed terms, milestone, currency, line items and tax treatment approved by Finance.

workflows.name: Expense review pack
workflows.description: Prepare a category review without posting to the ledger.
workflows.placeholder: Expense description, receipt reference, date, amount/currency and approved category dictionary.

name: HR & Talent
mandate: Prepare role and onboarding materials from approved policies while keeping personal employee records restricted.
focus: Use role-level information and keep employment decisions with people.
starterTasks: Name the HR reviewer and restricted record owner
Approve role profiles and onboarding policy
Confirm personal-data exclusions

workflows.name: Role description draft
workflows.description: Structure a role brief using approved responsibilities and requirements.
workflows.placeholder: Role purpose, responsibilities, essential skills, reporting line and approved working conditions. No candidate data.

workflows.name: Onboarding plan
workflows.description: Prepare a role-based onboarding plan with owners and milestones.
workflows.placeholder: Role, start milestone, policy references, required access and responsible teams. Avoid personal identifiers.

name: Operations
mandate: Coordinate owners, dates, programme logistics and actionable status across agreed department handoffs.
focus: Make every next action have an owner and a date.
metrics: Tasks with owner and due date
starterTasks: Confirm the work-tracking system
Approve programme logistics checklists
Agree the weekly reporting cadence

workflows.name: Weekly status brief
workflows.description: Prepare a status review from current work and reported blockers.
workflows.placeholder: Completed work, upcoming milestones, blockers, owner changes and decisions needed.

workflows.name: Minutes and action register
workflows.description: Turn approved meeting notes into a reviewable action record.
workflows.placeholder: Meeting purpose, confirmed decisions, action items, owners and dates. Supply only approved notes.

name: Client Success
mandate: Coordinate follow-through, evaluation milestones, feedback and permissioned proof of client outcomes.
focus: Connect client follow-up to agreed outcomes and evidence.
starterTasks: Confirm client account owners and engagement access
Approve check-in milestones and feedback questions
Define testimonial and case-study permissions

workflows.name: 30 / 60 / 90 check-in
workflows.description: Prepare a client check-in against the agreed engagement milestones.
workflows.placeholder: Milestone, agreed outcomes, known observations, questions and approved next steps.

workflows.name: Outcome and ROI evidence pack
workflows.description: Separate measured outcomes from assumptions before drafting an ROI report.
workflows.placeholder: Baseline, observed change, measurement period, evidence links, costs if verified and limitations.

name: Legal & Compliance
mandate: Prepare issue lists and document requests for qualified review, with controlled contracts, permissions and claims.
focus: Keep legal conclusions and approvals with the authorised reviewer.
starterTasks: Name the authorised legal and privacy reviewers
Approve clause library and document versions
Confirm permissions and processing review routes

workflows.name: Contract review issue list
workflows.description: Prepare an issue checklist against a client-approved clause library.
workflows.placeholder: Document reference, transaction context, approved clause checklist and issues already identified. Use redacted excerpts.

workflows.name: NDA preparation brief
workflows.description: Collect the approved inputs needed by the legal reviewer for an NDA.
workflows.placeholder: Parties, purpose, confidentiality scope, approved template/version, term and authorised reviewer.
